SELECT
FROM post_comments pc JOIN users u ON u.id = pc.user_id LEFT JOIN post_comments parent ON parent.id = pc.parent_comment_id LEFT JOIN post_comments reply_target ON reply_target.id = pc.reply_to_comment_id AND reply_target.post_id = pc.post_id LEFT JOIN users reply_target_user ON reply_target_user.id = reply_target.user_id WHERE pc.post_id = #{postId} AND ( ( pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND ( pc.deleted = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_comments reply WHERE reply.parent_comment_id = pc.id AND reply.post_id = pc.post_id AND reply.deleted = 0 ) ) ) OR ( pc.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL AND pc.deleted = 0 AND parent.id IS NOT NULL AND parent.post_id = pc.post_id AND parent.parent_comment_id IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN pc.created_at ELSE parent.created_at END ASC, CASE WHEN pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN pc.id ELSE parent.id END ASC, CASE WHEN pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, pc.created_at ASC, pc.id ASC

SELECT
FROM post_comments pc JOIN users u ON u.id = pc.user_id LEFT JOIN post_comments reply_target ON reply_target.id = pc.reply_to_comment_id AND reply_target.post_id = pc.post_id LEFT JOIN users reply_target_user ON reply_target_user.id = reply_target.user_id WHERE pc.post_id = #{postId} AND pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND ( pc.deleted = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_comments active_reply WHERE active_reply.parent_comment_id = pc.id AND active_reply.post_id = pc.post_id AND active_reply.deleted = 0 ) )
ORDER BY pc.created_at ASC, pc.id ASC
ORDER BY likeCount DESC, pc.created_at DESC, pc.id DESC
ORDER BY pc.created_at DESC, pc.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

#{rootId}
AND pc.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pc.created_at ASC, pc.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comments pc WHERE pc.post_id = #{postId} AND pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND ( pc.deleted = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_comments active_reply WHERE active_reply.parent_comment_id = pc.id AND active_reply.post_id = pc.post_id AND active_reply.deleted = 0 ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT root.id FROM post_comments target JOIN post_comments root ON root.id = COALESCE(target.parent_comment_id, target.id) AND root.post_id = target.post_id AND root.parent_comment_id IS NULL JOIN user_posts p ON p.id = target.post_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE target.id = #{commentId} AND target.post_id = #{postId} AND target.deleted = 0 AND ( root.deleted = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_comments active_reply WHERE active_reply.parent_comment_id = root.id AND active_reply.post_id = root.post_id AND active_reply.deleted = 0 ) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comments preceding JOIN post_comments target_root ON target_root.id = #{rootId} AND target_root.post_id = #{postId} AND target_root.parent_comment_id IS NULL WHERE preceding.post_id = #{postId} AND preceding.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND ( preceding.deleted = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_comments active_reply WHERE active_reply.parent_comment_id = preceding.id AND active_reply.post_id = preceding.post_id AND active_reply.deleted = 0 ) ) AND ( (target_root.created_at IS NULL AND preceding.created_at IS NOT NULL) OR preceding.created_at > target_root.created_at OR ( (preceding.created_at = target_root.created_at OR (preceding.created_at IS NULL AND target_root.created_at IS NULL)) AND preceding.id > target_root.id ) )
